## In this session

-   **Information on the programmes**: MA Major, MA Minor, and the doctoral track
-   **Introductions** — who is in the room and what they bring
-   **Individual consultations**

## The programmes

What the Major, the Minor and the doctoral track actually require: modules, credits, deadlines,
who to ask about what, and how the Lab and the
[Intro](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/) fit into them.

## Introductions

Everyone introduces themselves briefly. Come with an answer to one of these — whichever fits
your situation:

::: {.callout-note title="If you are here for the Minor"}
-   What interests me about DH?
-   In which direction can I imagine a project (*Projektarbeit*)?
:::

::: {.callout-note title="If you are here for the Major"}
-   Which discipline do I come from?
-   Which direction is my focus?
-   Which institutions or projects appeal to me, and could be candidates for an MA thesis?
:::

Think about this before the session. It is the starting point of the individual consultations,
and for many people it turns into the topic of the [Lab
assignment](/contents/assignment.qmd).

## Individual consultations

Slots are arranged in the session. Bring your study plan and any open questions about
recognition of credits, thesis topics or supervision.

## Practical matters

-   **Bring your own laptop** from Session 2 onwards
-   Set up [Zotero](https://www.zotero.org/) (this week) and
    [GitHub](https://github.com/) (next week) — announced in the
    [Intro](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/01.html)
